agent_evaluation.anti_lookahead_en: All agent features are computed from snapshot data ≤ signal time; outcomes only from data after the signal. No data leakage by construction.

sample_independence.note: Signals on the same 4H close share market conditions, so outcomes are not fully independent — the effective sample is smaller than n.

agent_evaluation.validation: Semua temuan bersifat EKSPLORATIF. Validasi out-of-sample membutuhkan holdout kronologis BERDASARKAN KELOMPOK CLOSE: begitu n_evaluable_30m ≥ 40, close 4H utuh pertama (sampai ≥ 20 sinyal) menjadi discovery set dan close berikutnya validation set — tidak ada close yang terbelah. Sampai saat itu tidak ada klaim akurasi prediksi.
agent_evaluation.validation_en: All findings are EXPLORATORY. Out-of-sample validation requires a chronological holdout BY CLOSE CLUSTER: once n_evaluable_30m ≥ 40, the first whole 4H closes (until ≥ 20 signals) become the discovery set and later closes the validation set — no close is split. Until then there is no predictive accuracy claim.

primary.note: Exit net = round-trip: gross - (spread + fee 8 bps). Satu full spread (setengah masuk + setengah keluar) + fee round-trip 8 bps — dikoreksi v1.1.0 (dulu 2x, double-count). Varian incl-impact di tiap strategi tambah 2x impact $10k sebagai proxy slippage. HOLD = keluar di close horizon. Strategi terbaik di +12H dipilih dari mean net round-trip — bukan bukti tervalidasi.
primary.note_en: Exit net is round-trip: gross - (spread + 8 bps fee). One full spread (half in + half out) + 8 bps round-trip fee — corrected in v1.1.0 (was 2x, double-counted). The incl-impact variant in each strategy adds 2x the $10k impact as a slippage proxy. HOLD exits at the horizon close. The best +12H strategy is picked by mean round-trip net — not validated evidence.

validation_split.note: Discovery = close sebelum flood (23 Nov 23:00 WIB); validation = flood + close sesudahnya. Satu close = satu kondisi pasar — jangan perlakukan 294 sinyal flood sebagai 294 sampel independen.
validation_split.note_en: Discovery = closes before the flood (23 Nov 23:00 WIB); validation = flood + later closes. One close = one market condition — do not treat the 294 flood signals as 294 independent samples.

split.note: Cluster-aware split by 4H close: whole closes, chronological, until >= 20 evaluable signals. No close is split between discovery and validation. The split is frozen and never changed.

notes: Semua hasil di sini SIMULASI dari candle 4H lokal — bukan sinyal produksi, bukan rekomendasi trading.
Kalibrasi A0 harus cocok ≥99% dengan scanner sebelum config lain diinterpretasikan.
Discovery = close sebelum flood; validation = flood + sesudahnya. Config yang bagus di discovery harus dikonfirmasi di validation.

Kalibrasi dedup-shift: 2 sent-missing (IDOL, PARTI) terjadi karena replay menangkap sinyal extra backfill satu close sebelumnya, yang lalu menekan sinyal asli berikutnya (dedup 3 close) — bukan kesalahan replay.
Hipotesis lab (LH1–LH7) BEKU; validasi memakai HANYA close setelah created_ts.
notes_en: All results here are SIMULATIONS from local 4H candles — not production signals, not trading advice.
A0 calibration must match the scanner at ≥99% before other configs are interpreted.
Discovery = closes before the flood; validation = flood + later closes. A config that looks good on discovery must be confirmed on validation.

validation_split.note: Discovery = close sebelum flood (23 Nov 23:00 WIB); validation = flood + close sesudahnya. Satu close = satu kondisi pasar — jangan perlakukan 294 sinyal flood sebagai 294 sampel independen.
validation_split.note_en: Discovery = closes before the flood (23 Nov 23:00 WIB); validation = flood + later closes. One close = one market condition — do not treat the 294 flood signals as 294 independent samples.

correlation.note: Return BTC/ETH di jendela +4H yang sama (close sinyal -> close 4H berikutnya), dari candle Mainnet lokal. Deskriptif — bukan klaim hedge atau prediksi.

checks.name: Survivorship bias
checks.note: Simbol delisted tetap dihitung outcome-nya dari candle lokal; bila ada yang hilang, itu survivorship bias.
checks.note_en: Delisted symbols still get their outcomes computed from local candles; any missing one is survivorship bias.

checks.name: Selection bias
checks.note: Gate table loser + counterfactual berpasangan winner/loser + Group A lengkap = tidak hanya mempelajari winner.
checks.note_en: Loser gate table + paired winner/loser counterfactuals + complete Group A = winners are not studied alone.

checks.name: Overfitting (tested vs closes)
checks.note: Lebih banyak objek diuji daripada close independen — disiplin split beku + tidak ada re-optimasi harian adalah penjaganya, bukan bukti tidak ada overfitting.
checks.note_en: More objects tested than independent closes — the frozen split discipline and no daily re-optimization are the guardrails, not proof against overfitting.

checks.name: Multiple testing
checks.note: Verdict berbasis gap (bukan p-value), jadi koreksi Bonferroni formal tidak dapat diterapkan — angka harapan false positive hanya konteks deskriptif.
checks.note_en: Verdicts are gap-based, not p-values, so a formal Bonferroni correction cannot be applied — the expected false-positive figure is descriptive context only.

checks.name: Parameter sensitivity
checks.note: Sensitivitas dilaporkan sebagai rentang antar-config — bukan ambang pass/fail. Rentang besar = kesimpulan bergantung pada pilihan parameter.
checks.note_en: Sensitivity is reported as the range across configs — not a pass/fail threshold. A wide range means conclusions depend on the parameter choice.

checks.name: Walk-forward validation
checks.note: Train mengembang, test 5 close berikutnya. n kecil — fold dengan test n<5 sinyal ditandai; gap train-test adalah ukuran optimisme.
checks.note_en: Expanding train, test on the next 5 closes. Small n — folds with test n<5 signals are flagged; the train-test gap measures optimism.

checks.name: Prospective validation
checks.note: Bila prospective closes = 0, semua verdict sejauh ini berbasis close flood yang sudah terlihat saat hipotesis ditulis — bukan validasi prospektif murni.
checks.note_en: When prospective closes = 0, all verdicts so far rest on the flood close, which was already visible when the hypotheses were written — not purely prospective validation.

checks.name: Cluster dependency
checks.note: Gap signal-weighted vs close-weighted > 1pp = satu cluster (flood) mendominasi kesimpulan signal-weighted.
checks.note_en: A signal- vs close-weighted gap > 1pp means one cluster (the flood) dominates signal-weighted conclusions.

checks.name: Reproducibility
checks.note: Versi state file + learnings harus cocok dengan spec yang berlaku; hitung ulang independen harus cocok dalam toleransi.
checks.note_en: State-file and learnings versions must match the specs in force; independent recomputation must agree within tolerance.

validation_research.limitations: Audit ini memeriksa konstruksi + angka yang ada; ia tidak dapat membuktikan tidak adanya bias yang belum terpikirkan. Walk-forward memakai n kecil. Verdict gap-based bukan uji signifikansi.
validation_research.limitations_en: This audit checks construction and existing figures; it cannot prove the absence of unthought-of biases. Walk-forward uses small n. Gap-based verdicts are not significance tests.

timeline.title: Phase 1 live (research v1.0.0)
timeline.text: Breakout + Reversal + Performance Learning. 25 signals analyzed; deterministic only; non-blocking pipeline.
timeline.text_id: Breakout + Reversal + Pembelajaran Kinerja. 25 sinyal dianalisis; deterministik saja; pipeline non-blocking.

timeline.title: Phase 2 live (research v2.0.0 → v2.1.0)
timeline.text: Order Flow + Market Regime + Liquidity agents; Binance vision archive (OI / funding / bookDepth); live book_top10 snapshot at signal time; data quality report; immutable version history.
timeline.text_id: Agent Arus Order + Rezim Pasar + Likuiditas; arsip Binance vision (OI / funding / bookDepth); snapshot book_top10 live saat sinyal; laporan kualitas data; riwayat versi immutable.

timeline.title: Phase 3 live (this dashboard)
timeline.text: AI Research Dashboard: overview, per-signal intelligence, insights, learning timeline, data explorer.
timeline.text_id: Dashboard Riset AI: ikhtisar, intelijen per sinyal, insight, linimasa pembelajaran, penjelajah data.

timeline.title: Phase 4 live (data quality & learning reliability)
timeline.text: Sticky outcome horizons (+1H recovered from 0% via validated vision backfill with provenance); pipeline coverage checks; horizon/outlier/per-marker learning evaluations; fail-closed research.json validation.
timeline.text_id: Horizon hasil yang sticky (+1H dipulihkan dari 0% lewat backfill vision tervalidasi dengan provenance); pemeriksaan cakupan pipeline; evaluasi pembelajaran horizon/outlier/per-marker; validasi research.json yang fail-closed.

timeline.title: Phase 4.1 live (learning validation)
timeline.text: Paired horizon comparison on the same signal cohort; outlier & robustness analysis (distribution, per-signal contributions, mean vs win rate); all six agents evaluated against actual outcomes — exploratory only, no predictive accuracy claimed.
timeline.text_id: Perbandingan horizon berpasangan pada kohort sinyal yang sama; analisis outlier & robustness (distribusi, kontribusi per sinyal, mean vs win rate); keenam agent dievaluasi terhadap hasil sebenarnya — eksploratif saja, tanpa klaim akurasi prediktif.

timeline.title: Phase 4.2 live (continuous learning)
timeline.text: Research checkpoints at 40/60/100 complete outcomes; frozen hypothesis registry tested only on newer data; exploration/validation time split; auto-generated learning summary with change tracking. No new agents, no scanner changes.
timeline.text_id: Checkpoint riset di 40/60/100 hasil lengkap; registri hipotesis beku yang hanya diuji pada data yang lebih baru; split eksplorasi/validasi berdasarkan waktu; ringkasan pembelajaran otomatis dengan pelacakan perubahan. Tanpa agent baru, tanpa perubahan scanner.

timeline.title: Learning validation fixes (frozen snapshots, 1H recovery, cluster-aware evaluation)
timeline.title_id: Perbaikan validasi pembelajaran (snapshot beku, pemulihan 1J, evaluasi cluster-aware)
timeline.text: Operational Learning Validation audit fixed the sync churn (generated_ts + rebuilt snapshots) and froze snapshots at first analysis. 1H context for older signals is reconstructed from the official Binance archive, labeled HISTORICAL RECONSTRUCTION, never merged into the frozen snapshot. Evaluation is now cluster-aware: statistics per 4H close, and the exploration/validation split keeps whole closes together.
timeline.text_id: Audit Operational Learning Validation memperbaiki churn sync (generated_ts + snapshot yang dibangun ulang) dan membekukan snapshot pada analisis pertama. Konteks 1J untuk sinyal lama direkonstruksi dari arsip resmi Binance, dilabeli REKONSTRUKSI HISTORIS, tidak pernah digabung ke snapshot beku. Evaluasi kini cluster-aware: statistik per penutupan 4J, dan split eksplorasi/validasi menjaga seluruh penutupan tetap bersama.

timeline.title: Bilingual research (research v2.2.0)
timeline.text: Every agent observation, note, and learning summary is now published in both English and Indonesian; the dashboard switches language with the main page's preference. Numbers, thresholds, and logic unchanged — only the language is new.
timeline.text_id: Setiap observasi, catatan, dan ringkasan pembelajaran agent kini diterbitkan dalam bahasa Inggris dan Indonesia; dashboard berganti bahasa mengikuti preferensi halaman utama. Angka, ambang batas, dan logika tidak berubah — hanya bahasanya yang baru.

timeline.title: Long horizons (research v2.3.0)
timeline.text: Monitored horizons are now 4H, 12H, 1D, 2D, 3D, and 1W, all read from local 4H candles — a 4H signal needs more than 8 hours to judge. The tracker classification (win-rate basis) and the paired cohort stay unchanged underneath.
timeline.text_id: Horizon yang dipantau kini 4J, 12J, 1H, 2H, 3H, dan 1M, semuanya dibaca dari candle 4J lokal — sinyal 4J butuh lebih dari 8 jam untuk dinilai. Klasifikasi tracker (dasar win rate) dan kohort paired tetap tidak berubah di baliknya.

breakout.notes: Kekuatan struktur: Badan candle kuat (100% dari range) — pembeli mendominasi bar sinyal. Taker-buy dominan (0.74) — agresi beli jelas. Struktur EMA bullish: close > EMA20 > EMA50. MACD bullish: garis di atas sinyal, histogram positif dan membesar. Volatilitas rendah: ATR14 0.0% dari harga. Tidak ada resistance 4H di atas close dalam 60 bar terakhir (di luar level breakout itu sendiri). Struktur HH 3/4 dan HL 3/4 — tren naik terkonfirmasi di struktur harga. Yang perlu diperhatikan: Breakout tipis: close hanya 0.02% di atas high 20 bar — mudah kembali ke bawah level. RSI 4H sangat panas (81.2) — momentum sudah sangat jauh.
breakout.notes_en: Structural strengths: Strong candle body (100% of range) — buyers dominated the signal bar. Dominant taker-buy (0.74) — clear buying aggression. Bullish EMA structure: close > EMA20 > EMA50. MACD bullish: line above signal, histogram positive and growing. Low volatility: ATR14 0.0% of price. No 4H resistance above the close in the last 60 bars (other than the breakout level itself). HH 3/4 and HL 3/4 structure — uptrend confirmed in price structure. Watch out for: Marginal breakout: close only 0.02% above the 20-bar high — easily falls back below the level. RSI 4H extremely hot (81.2) — momentum is already very stretched.
